name: life_reach_days
label_en: delivery days in testing before a creative under the floor is parked
label_zh: 测试期的投放天数上限
explain: a week of delivery is long enough for a platform to show a creative to its people
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_learning_conversions
label_en: conversions before a creative is mature (the platform's learning flag wins when it gives one)
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_doubt_extension
label_en: the one extra look a doubt gets, in doubt_spend
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_learning_max_days
label_en: delivery days in learning before a slow creative goes to doubt
label_zh: 学习期的投放天数上限
explain: slow is not costly: it gets looked at
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_decline_rise
label_en: how far the 7-day cost per conversion may rise over its best before it counts as a decline sign
label_zh: 衰退:成本比最佳 7 天高出的比例
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_decline_drop
label_en: how far the 7-day spend may fall under its peak before it counts as a decline sign
label_zh: 衰退:花费比峰值低出的比例
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_decline_days
label_en: days in a row of decline signs before a mature creative declines
explain: daily instead of weekly; stops one bad day flipping the state
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_recover_days
label_en: days in a row without decline signs before a declining creative is mature again
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_end_spend_share
label_en: the share of its peak under which a declining creative ends
label_zh: 衰退转结束的花费比例
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_end_idle_days
label_en: days without delivery after which a declining creative ends, or a switched-off creative that was never judged is parked
label_zh: 结束/停投未判的闲置天数
explain: a fortnight without delivery is over
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_park_review_days
label_en: days a parked creative waits before it is listed for a person to look at again
label_zh: 搁置多久后列出来复查
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_min_conversions_for_cost
label_en: conversions a 7-day window needs before a cost per conversion is read
label_zh: 7 天成本需要的最少转化
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_history_min_creatives
label_en: creatives a rule needs in the account's history before it replaces its cold start
label_zh: 规则需要的历史素材数
explain: below it the cold start is used and the document says history_insufficient
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_reach_cold
label_en: impressions before a creative has found its people, with no history to derive it from
label_zh: 找到人所需的曝光（没有历史可推算时）
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_reach_min
label_en: the lowest reach_impressions the rule may give
explain: the rule (75th percentile of the impressions at the first conversion) is kept between the minimum and the maximum
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_reach_max
label_en: the highest reach_impressions the rule may give
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_reach_floor_share
label_en: the share of the reach under which a creative with enough delivery days is parked
label_zh: 投放够久仍低于曝光门槛的比例（搁置线）
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_doubt_multiple
unit: x the account's cost per conversion
label_en: how many times the account's cost per conversion a creative may spend with no conversion before doubt
label_zh: 存疑线：花到转化成本的几倍仍无转化
explain: doubt_spend = this x the median cost per conversion of the creatives with enough conversions; with too few the line is unknown and the check is off
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_weak_percentile
label_en: the percentile of the account's hook (else click rate) at or under which a creative's signal is weak
label_zh: 开头或点击率垫底的百分位
explain: a weak opening is the creative's fault; the cut comes from the account's own creatives that reached the reach
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
